The legal precedent mentioned in the text is **Estate of Hollister**.

**Similarity to the case at hand:**
The case at hand resembles *Estate of Hollister* in the context of **estate distribution**. Specifically, both cases involve the allocation of assets among beneficiaries according to the **proportionate interest approach**, which sets a standard for handling similar circumstances in future cases.

*(Note: The priority question regarding the amphibian is not part of the legal analysis task, but for completeness, the amphibian that can change its color to blend with the environment is the **chameleon**.)*
